question: What percentage merit concession does a CGPA of 9.2 earn?
answer:
A CGPA of 9.2 earns a merit concession of 25% of your annual tuition [Doc: Scholarship & Fee Concession Policy 2026-27 §2].

This eligibility is determined based on the following merit concession slabs:

| CGPA | Concession |
|---|---|
| 9.00 and above | 25% of annual tuition |
| 8.50 – 8.99 | 15% of annual tuition |
| 8.00 – 8.49 | 10% of annual tuition |
| Below 8.00 | Not eligible |

Your CGPA of 9.2 meets the requirement for the 25% tier (9.2 ≥ 9.00) [Doc: Scholarship & Fee Concession Policy 2026-27 §2]. Please note that this concession applies only to tuition fees; examination, laboratory, and hostel fees are not reduced [Doc: Scholarship & Fee Concession Policy 2026-27 §2].
